check.h1: Scan anything before you trust it
check.p: Five checks, one risk score. Paste, upload, or scan — get a clear Safe / Risky verdict in seconds.
check.smsDesc: Paste any SMS or WhatsApp text to see if it's spam, phishing, or an OTP-fraud attempt.
check.linkDesc: Checks any URL or QR code against live threat-intelligence blocklists before you open it.
check.pdfDesc: Upload loan-app PDFs, 'govt scheme' files, or attachments to detect hidden scripts or malware.
check.callDesc: Step-by-step guide to dial your carrier's code and confirm no one has silently forwarded your calls.
check.emailDesc: Paste a suspicious email — sender address, subject & body — to detect phishing, spoofing and scam patterns.

smsCheck.p: Paste the full SMS, WhatsApp, or Telegram message below. Our engine checks for OTP fraud, phishing links, fake KYC urgency, and prize scam patterns.
smsCheck.hint: Your message is never stored. Analysis happens server-side and results are discarded after display.

linkCheck.p: Enter a URL or upload a QR code image. We check it against Google Safe Browsing, VirusTotal, and PhishTank in parallel.
linkCheck.qrUpload: Drop QR image here or click to upload
linkCheck.hint: Supports .jpg, .png, .gif, .webp QR images. We decode the URL on your device, never upload the image.

pdfCheck.p: Upload any suspicious document. We check for hidden JavaScript, auto-run scripts, embedded executables, and run AV engine checks.
pdfCheck.dropzone: Drop PDF or file here, or click to browse
pdfCheck.hint: Max 10 MB. Your file is deleted automatically after scanning — never retained.

callCheck.p: There's no public API to check call forwarding for you — but you can check it yourself in under 60 seconds with your phone's keypad.
callCheck.step1h: Dial this code on your phone
callCheck.step1p: Open your phone dialler and call *#21# — this shows if unconditional call forwarding is active.
callCheck.step2safe: If it says 'Not active' or 'Disabled' — you're safe.
callCheck.step2risk: If it shows a forwarding number you don't recognize — act immediately.
callCheck.step3p: Dial *#62# (no-answer forwarding) and *#67# (busy forwarding) and check those too.
callCheck.step4p: Dial ##002# to cancel all call and data forwarding on any GSM network.
callCheck.panicBtn: 🚨 Forwarding is ON — I didn't set this! What do I do?
callCheck.carrierNote: Codes work on all Indian carriers: Airtel, Jio, BSNL, Vi.

emailCheck.p: Paste the suspicious email — sender address, subject line, and body text. We check for domain spoofing, phishing patterns, fake urgency, and embedded malicious links.
emailCheck.bodyPlaceholder: Paste the full email body here…
emailCheck.hint: Your email content is never stored or logged. Analysis is done server-side and results are discarded immediately.

scams.p: Each scam follows a pattern. Spot the pattern, spot the scam.

laws.p: Simplified from the IT Act 2000 (as amended), Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita 2023, DPDP Act 2023, and RBI/IT Rules. Not legal advice.
laws.disclaimer: Section numbers and timelines are simplified for public awareness and may be amended. Always confirm current provisions via cybercrime.gov.in or a legal professional before relying on them for a filing.

grievance.h1: The right complaint, to the right authority
grievance.p: Different problems go to different bodies. Pick your track below.
grievance.trackADesc: Fraud, hacking, harassment — file in the first few hours
grievance.trackBDesc: Transaction fraud, unauthorized debit, fake loan app
grievance.trackCDesc: Harassment, fake post, platform not responding
grievance.trackD: Crime against a woman or child
grievance.draftDesc: Fill in the details below and we'll format a complaint text you can copy directly into the portal.
grievance.draftNote: Copy this text and paste it into the relevant portal. Do not share your OTP, passwords, or Aadhaar number in the complaint.

helpline.h1: Report it now — every hour matters
helpline.p: Financial cybercrime complaints filed within the first few hours have a real chance of freezing the transaction before the money moves further. Don't wait, don't feel embarrassed — call.
helpline.urgentNote: ⚠ Live financial fraud? Call 1930 immediately, before filing the online complaint — the call can trigger a faster transaction freeze with your bank.

about.p: A citizen digital-literacy initiative concept. Legal information is simplified for awareness; always verify current provisions and consult the helpline or a lawyer for your specific case.
about.privacyText: We do not store your scanned messages, links, or files. All scans are processed server-side and discarded after display. We collect only anonymized aggregate statistics (verdict counts, scam pattern frequency) to track trends. No personal data is retained.

qrScanner.title: Scan a QR code
qrScanner.cameraInstruction: Point your camera at a QR code and hold steady.
qrScanner.urlDecoded: The link has been placed in the URL field. Scan it to check for known threats and suspicious indicators before opening it.
qrScanner.nonUrlDecoded: This QR code does not contain a standard web URL. Review the content carefully; it has not been verified as safe.
qrScanner.privacy: QR decoding happens on this device. Only a URL you choose to scan is sent to the link-analysis service. A decoded QR code is not automatically safe.
qrScanner.cameraUnavailable: Camera access is unavailable in this browser or app wrapper. Open the secure website in Chrome or update the APK wrapper to support camera access.
qrScanner.cameraDenied: Camera permission was denied. Allow camera access in your browser or app settings, then try again.
qrScanner.cameraFailed: Could not open the camera. Check that another app is not using it and that camera permission is enabled.
qrScanner.invalidImage: Choose a valid QR code image.
qrScanner.noQr: No readable QR code was found. Try a clearer, well-lit image.
qrScanner.imageFailed: Could not read this image. Please try another QR image.
qrScanner.imageOpenFailed: Could not open this image. Please try another file.
qrScanner.hint: Decode QR codes on your device; scan links before opening them.
